svg.title: Thus the same controls recover both the scalar limit and the solver’s norm bill. Finally if Bi ≤2Hi and HN i ei →0 for every fixed N, then ∥Biei∥≤2Hi∥ei∥→0. Applying this to both preexisting detector errors recovers the paid running-factor transfer used in TR42–TR44. No unbounded coordinate error is suppressed by merely taking an unweighted limit.
